name: restate/sdk
description: Restate SDK for PHP: durable handlers, served through the Restate PHP extension.

suggest.restate/ingress: Calls Restate services from code that is not a handler.
suggest.restate/testing: Runs Restate and an endpoint for integration tests; install it with --dev.
suggest.symfony/property-access: Useful for standalone Symfony ObjectNormalizer DTO hydration with Restate\Bridge\Symfony\SymfonyJsonPayloadAdapter.
suggest.symfony/property-info: Useful for standalone Symfony ObjectNormalizer type extraction with Restate\Bridge\Symfony\SymfonyJsonPayloadAdapter.
